title: trump_tiger_posts_short
question: Should the president delete these posts? Comment below

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: *Trump* / posted a man's / final moments / online.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: A man was killed by a *tiger* at a wildlife park in England.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: His family begged people to *stop sharing* the video.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: That same day, Trump posted it to *13 million followers*. Caption: *Don't ever mess with nature*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Hours later, he posted an *AI video* of himself wrestling and hugging a tiger, set to *The Lion Sleeps Tonight*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: In it, the AI Trump even *copies a hand gesture* the man made during the real attack.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Even his old friend Piers Morgan said: *appallingly tasteless. Delete it*.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: South Yorkshire's mayor said the president was *using AI to mock* a family's grief.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: The White House gave *no explanation*, and only referred reporters to the posts.

lines.speaker: Reporter
lines.text: Should the president *delete them*? Tell us in the comments.
